summary: Oncolytics Biotech filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) furnishing a September 28, 2026 press release on operational progress in its REO 033 randomized study of pelareorep plus FOLFIRI/bevacizumab versus FOLFIRI/bevacizumab in second-line RAS-mutant MSS metastatic colorectal cancer. Nearly all Part A sites are activated, with multiple patients enrolled; Part A targets approximately 60 randomized patients, ORR primary endpoint, PFS/OS/safety/biomarkers secondary. The company cites FDA alignment supporting a potential accelerated-approval path on ORR and full approval on PFS, expecting sufficient Part A data for an interim clinical update by year-end 2026. This is a routine clinical-update disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. Watch enrollment cadence and the year-end interim readout as the key clinical catalysts.
